blocks.text: Group 1 (alkali metals) aur Group 2 (alkaline earth metals) dono reactive dhaatein hain, lekin ionization energies ki wajah se mukhtalif hain. Group 1 ki dhaat ke paas khone ko sirf aik electron hai aur woh aasani se +1 ion banati hai; Group 2 ki dhaat ko do electrons khone parte hain jis mein zyada tawanai lagti hai, is liye woh reactive lekin aam taur par usi period ki Group 1 dhaat se kam hai. Dono groups mein atoms bare aur ionization energy kam hone se reactivity neeche barhti hai.
